title: Trendy Threads imported product audit
method: Each source URL opened in a fresh Chrome browser context with no sign-in or access-control bypass. Only pages that retained the exact supplied product identity were considered matching; redirected ASIN mismatches were excluded.
price_policy: A current price is verified only when the public page preserved the exact product identity and exposed a price. Listings without a verifiable current price remain visible but cannot be checked out. Historical order records are retained.
description_policy: A description is marked meaningful when stored catalog text has at least 40 characters after trimming; stale price/SEO snippets were removed.
production_image_check: Every product image rendered in Chrome on the public site; this does not establish reuse rights for retailer CDN images.
